<mxfile host="app.diagrams.net" scale="1" border="0"> <diagram name="Page-1" id="IdYcBj8gqoLg4ikzF5FY"> <mxGraphModel dx="2657" dy="1235" grid="1" gridSize="10" guides="1" tooltips="1" connect="1" arrows="1" fold="1" page="1" pageScale="1" pageWidth="850" pageHeight="1100" math="0" shadow="0"> <root> <mxCell id="0" /> <mxCell id="1" parent="0" /> <UserObject label="" mermaidData="{
 "data": "classDiagram
 direction LR

 class User {
 -ObjectId id
 -String fullName {required}
 -String email {unique, required}
 -String password {hashed, select:false}
 -Enum role [learner/trainer/admin]
 -String status
 -Date createdAt
 +User register(data)
 +Token login(email, password)
 +User getProfile()
 +void hashPassword()
 +Boolean comparePassword()
 }

 class Course {
 -ObjectId id
 -String title {required}
 -String shortDescription
 -String fullDescription
 -String[] objectives
 -Enum level [beginner/intermediate/advanced]
 -String category
 -Number duration
 -Enum status [draft/published]
 -ObjectId trainer {ref: User}
 -Date createdAt
 -Date publishedAt
 +Course createCourse(data)
 +Course updateCourse(id, data)
 +void publishCourse()
 +Course[] getPublishedCourses(filter)
 +Course getCourseById(id)
 }

 class Module {
 -ObjectId id
 -String title {required}
 -String description
 -Number order {required, unique per course}
 -Number duration
 -Enum status [draft/published]
 -ObjectId course {ref: Course}
 +Module createModule(data)
 +Module updateModule(id, data)
 +void reorderModules()
 +Module[] getModulesByCourse(courseId)
 }

 class Resource {
 -ObjectId id
 -String title {required}
 -Enum type [article/video/pdf/image/link/exercise/github]
 -String urlOrFilePath {required}
 -String description
 -String originalFileName
 -Number fileSize
 -Number duration
 -Number displayOrder
 -ObjectId module {ref: Module}
 +Resource uploadResource(file)
 +Resource[] getResourcesByModule(moduleId)
 +void deleteResource(id)
 }

 class Enrollment {
 -ObjectId id
 -ObjectId learner {ref: User}
 -ObjectId course {ref: Course}
 -Date enrollmentDate
 -Enum status [active/finished/cancelled]
 -Number globalProgress
 +Enrollment enroll(learnerId, courseId)
 +void cancelEnrollment()
 +Number calculateProgress()
 +Enrollment[] getMyEnrollments(learnerId)
 }

 class Progress {
 -ObjectId id
 -ObjectId learner {ref: User}
 -ObjectId course {ref: Course}
 -ObjectId module {ref: Module}
 -ObjectId resource {ref: Resource, optional}
 -Enum status [not_started/in_progress/completed]
 -Date startedAt
 -Date completionDate
 +Progress markResourceViewed()
 +Progress markModuleCompleted()
 +Number getProgressByCourse()
 }

 class Quiz {
 -ObjectId id
 -String title {required}
 -String description
 -Number minScore
 -Boolean isActive
 -ObjectId module {ref: Module, unique}
 +Quiz createQuiz(data)
 +Quiz getQuizForLearner()
 +Quiz getQuizForTrainer()
 }

 class Question {
 -String text {required}
 -String[] choices
 -String correctAnswer {hidden for learner}
 }

 class QuizAttempt {
 -ObjectId id
 -ObjectId learner {ref: User}
 -ObjectId quiz {ref: Quiz}
 -String[] submittedAnswers
 -Number score
 -Boolean passed
 -Date submittedAt
 +QuizAttempt submitAttempt(answers)
 +QuizAttempt[] getAttemptsByQuiz(quizId)
 }

 class Feedback {
 -ObjectId id
 -ObjectId trainer {ref: User}
 -ObjectId learner {ref: User}
 -ObjectId course {ref: Course}
 -String content {required}
 -Date createdAt
 +Feedback addFeedback(data)
 +Feedback[] getFeedbacksByCourse(courseId)
 }

 User \"1\" --> \"0..*\" Course : owns as trainer
 Course \"1\" *-- \"1..*\" Module : contains ordered
 Module \"1\" *-- \"0..*\" Resource : contains
 Module \"1\" --> \"0..1\" Quiz : has
 Quiz \"1\" *-- \"1..*\" Question : contains
 User \"1\" --> \"0..*\" Enrollment : enrolls
 Course \"1\" --> \"0..*\" Enrollment : has
 User \"1\" --> \"0..*\" Progress : tracks
 User \"1\" --> \"0..*\" QuizAttempt : submits
 Quiz \"1\" --> \"0..*\" QuizAttempt : has
 Course \"1\" --> \"0..*\" Feedback : receives
 User \"1\" --> \"0..*\" Feedback : gives as trainer
 User \"1\" --> \"0..*\" Feedback : writes as learner
 Course \"1\" --> \"0..*\" Progress : includes
 Module \"1\" --> \"0..*\" Progress : tracks
 Resource \"1\" --> \"0..*\" Progress : viewed in
 Course \"1\" --> \"0..*\" Enrollment : includes


 class User,Course,Module,Resource,Enrollment,Progress,Quiz,QuizAttempt,Feedback entity
 class Question nested",
